g.text: Crow's foot = many Bar = one Circle = optional (0)
User 1:1 Patient or Provider (exclusive by role). Patient N:M Provider through PatientAssignment.
Patient 1:N Symptom, TestResult, RiskAssessment, Alert, Referral. Facility 1:N Provider (optional) and 1:N Referral.
Selected attributes shown. Full field list is in prisma/schema.prisma. Production target is PostgreSQL; local demo may use SQLite.
